description: This source file defines utility enums and functions for managing environment variables, directory paths, and configuration files for the OpenClaw application. It provides mechanisms to retrieve environment variable overrides, determine directory URLs, and locate configuration files dynamically based on environment settings or default locations.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable's value for a given key, returning it as a trimmed string if available.

methods.name: resolveConfigCandidate
methods.description: Checks a specified directory for the presence of a configuration file named 'openclaw.json'.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Computes a URL for the application's state directory, either from environment variables or defaulting to a directory in the user's home folder.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Determines the URL of the main configuration file, prioritizing environment variable overrides, existing config files, or default paths.

methods.name: workspaceURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the workspace subdirectory within the state directory.
